verdict.rationale: DBOS's core library is explicitly described as open-source and its source is published on GitHub (dbos-transact-py), with docs repeatedly calling it an 'open-source Postgres-backed library' ([dbos-docs-2],[dbos-docs-20],[dbos-docs-35],[dbos-gh-1]). However, no evidence specifies the actual license type/terms, and community feedback notes the web UI/Conductor management console is NOT open-sourced ([dbos-comm-11]), limiting full openness to the core library only. Missing for 10: explicit license name/terms (e.g., MIT/Apache) citation, and confirmation that all product components (not just the core library) are open-source.
